route_summary: Boto3 AgentCore Runtime session helper that persists a caller-managed runtimeSessionId across invocations, streams real invocation responses, and explicitly stops sessions.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+ boto3 with AgentCore runtime model, deployed runtime ARN, compatible Region and buyer credentials. Each invocation can incur runtime/model cost; state and lifecycle are remote. Hosted preview does not execute or claim sessions.
